product_overview: Omni Browser Agent is an AI-driven backend service that executes autonomous browser automation, conducts web research, and extracts multimodal content using Playwright-driven agents and an LLM-based debate/synthesis engine. It exposes REST endpoints to run tasks and to synthesize ambiguous prompts via a debate engine.
core_goals: Enable reliable autonomous browser tasks (research, scraping, interaction) via a stable API
Provide robust, multi-method content extraction for YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn, and Twitter with graceful fallbacks
Resolve ambiguous or conflicting prompts using an LLM-based Debate Engine to produce actionable, unified instructions
Expose a simple REST surface (task and debate endpoints) that integrates intent routing and extractor pipelines
Support configurable runtime behavior (stealth, timeouts, inference temperature) and maintain secure, fault-tolerant operation

features.name: Execute Browser Task (POST /api/task)
features.description: Run an autonomous browser task (research, scraping, extraction, or interaction). The Task API accepts a prompt and parameters; the TaskRouter classifies intent and routes to the appropriate extractor or agent. Returns extracted data or error details.
user_flows: POST /api/task with JSON {task_type:"web_research", prompt:"Find the latest posts on x.com about AI"} -> Receive 200 with JSON {status:"completed", results:{...}}
POST /api/task with JSON {task_type:"browser_interaction", prompt:"Click through login and capture last page"} -> Receive 200 with JSON {status:"completed", artifacts:{screenshots, html}}
POST /api/task with JSON missing required field {prompt: ""} -> Receive 400 with validation error {error:"prompt is required"}
POST /api/task with malformed URL or unreachable target {task_type:"extract", url:"htp://bad"} -> Receive 422 with validation error {error:"invalid url"}

features.name: Debate Engine (POST /api/debate)
features.description: Run the built-in Debate Engine to reconcile or synthesize two conflicting/ambiguous prompts into a single actionable instruction set. Intended to be used standalone or invoked by TaskRouter when a prompt needs clarification.
user_flows: POST /api/debate with JSON {prompt_a:"Use selenium to scrape", prompt_b:"Use playwright to scrape without being slow"} -> Receive 200 with JSON {synthesized_prompt:"Use Playwright with stealth and adaptive waits; prefer non-blocking selectors", reasoning:{conflicts:[],overrides:[...]}} -> POST /api/task with JSON {task_type:"browser_task", prompt:"Use Playwright with stealth and adaptive waits; prefer non-blocking selectors"} -> Receive 200 with JSON {status:"completed", results:{...}}
POST /api/debate with JSON containing oversized or invalid payload -> Receive 422 Unprocessable Entity with validation details
POST /api/debate with valid prompts but internal LLM failure -> Receive 500 with JSON {error:"debate_failed", details:"LLM timeout or inference error"}

features.name: Intent Routing & Extractors (YouTube / Instagram / LinkedIn / Twitter) via Task Router
features.description: Automatic intent classification routes tasks to specialized extractor pipelines (YouTubeExtractor, InstagramExtractor, LinkedIn/Twitter extractors). Pipelines attempt multi-stage extraction (e.g., transcript via youtube-transcript-api -> yt-dlp -> metadata fallback). The Task API surfaces extractor used and fallback history in responses.
user_flows: POST /api/task with JSON {task_type:"extract", prompt:"Extract transcript and metadata from https://youtube.com/watch?v=XYZ"} -> Receive 200 with JSON {status:"completed", extractor:"YouTubeExtractor", data:{metadata:{title,author,duration}, transcript:"..."}}

POST /api/task with JSON {task_type:"extract", prompt:"Extract IG post https://instagram.com/p/ABC"} -> Receive 200 with JSON {status:"completed", extractor:"InstagramExtractor", data:{media:[...], captions:"..."}}

POST /api/task with YouTube URL where primary extraction fails {task_type:"extract", prompt:"Extract https://youtube.com/watch?v=XYZ"} -> Receive 200 with JSON {status:"partial", extractor:"YouTubeExtractor", fallbacks:["youtube-transcript-api failed","yt-dlp used"], data:{metadata:{...}, transcript:"auto-generated from audio"}, warnings:["primary transcript source failed; fallback used"]}

POST /api/task with a URL blocked or when all fallback methods fail {task_type:"extract", prompt:"Extract https://youtube.com/watch?v=XYZ"} -> Receive 500 with JSON {error:"extraction_failed", details:"all fallback methods exhausted"}

POST /api/task with ambiguous social prompt {task_type:"extract", prompt:"Get latest posts about AI from X"} -> Receive 202 with JSON {status:"needs_clarification", suggested_action:"invoke_debate"} -> POST /api/debate with JSON {prompt_a:(original), prompt_b:"Prefer timeline vs search?"} -> Receive 200 with synthesized_prompt -> POST /api/task with JSON {task_type:"extract", prompt:synthesized_prompt} -> Receive 200 with JSON {status:"completed", results:{...}}
